title: Bondy — bondy_db / oplog / MST
description: Storage & replication stack plus router, WAMP, HTTP and BEAM VM: Partisan cluster state, AAE frontier convergence with per-pair drill-down, WAL, applier, core substrate, MST page store.

panels.title: Scrape up
panels.description: Prometheus can reach the node's Admin API /metrics endpoint.

panels.title: Membership view size
panels.description: partisan_peer_service:members() as seen by each node.

panels.title: Cluster health
panels.description: 1 only when every node reaches every member of its view.

panels.title: Node ready
panels.description: Same flag the /ready probe serves.

panels.title: Active alarms
panels.description: OTP alarms (e.g. system_memory_high_watermark), all nodes.

panels.title: Connectivity matrix (observer × peer)
panels.description: Each cell: can the row's node reach the column's peer? Green = connected.

panels.title: Peer connectivity history
panels.description: Per (observer, peer) link state over time; red bands are partitions or restarts.

panels.title: Instances converged
panels.description: Instances whose applied-frontier hash is identical on every selected node (includes solo instances).

panels.title: Instances DIVERGED
panels.description: Instances reporting different applied-frontier hashes across nodes. Transient during writes; persistent divergence means AAE is not converging.

panels.title: AAE lww merge conflicts
panels.description: Remote AAE merges that replaced a DIFFERENT local value of an authorization cell (lww). Investigate any sustained activity: a concurrent edit lost.

panels.title: Sync session duration
panels.description: Distribution of AAE sync session durations.

panels.title: Peer root-checkpoint age (stalest pair vs typical)
panels.description: Age of the last CONFIRMED peer-root checkpoint per (shard, peer) pair — the reclamation-stability signal, NOT sync cadence. A quiet shard whose peer has fully compacted advertises no MST root, so its checkpoint is deliberately frozen even though sync sessions keep running (see the Sync sessions panel for cadence). Worry only if the MEDIAN grows while writes are flowing.

panels.title: Substrate AE freshness lag (max per namespace)
Frontier sync matrix — $nodeA ⇢ (diverged shard count per peer)
⇢ $nodeB
panels.description: Number of shards whose applied-frontier hash differs between $nodeA and $nodeB. Click to inspect the pair.

targets.expr: count(max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$nodeA"}) != max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$nodeB"})) or vector(0)
count(max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$pairA"}) != max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$pairB"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Last sync age ($pairA → $pairB)
panels.description: Oldest last-completed-sync across $pairA's instances against $pairB.

panels.title: Diverged shards between pair over time

targets.expr: count(max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$pairA"}) != max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$pairB"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Diverged shards: frontier seq delta ($pairA vs $pairB)
panels.description: Shards whose frontiers differ between the pair, with the absolute applied-sequence gap (how far apart).

targets.expr: abs(max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_seq_total{node="$pairA"}) - max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_seq_total{node="$pairB"})) and on (instance_id) (max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$pairA"}) != max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$pairB"}))

panels.title: Largest frontier gaps (top 15)

targets.expr: topk(15, abs(max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_seq_total{node="$pairA"}) - max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_seq_total{node="$pairB"})) and on (instance_id) (max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$pairA"}) != max by (instance_id) (bondy_oplog_instance_frontier_hash{node="$pairB"})))

panels.description: Applied-sequence gap per diverged shard between the pair.

panels.title: Appends vs applied (per node)
panels.description: Sustained applied < appends means the applier is falling behind.

panels.title: Replication progress — frontier seq total (per node)
panels.description: Monotone; a persistent gap between nodes is replication lag.

panels.title: Backpressure & fault event rates
panels.description: Everything here should normally be zero.

panels.title: WAL hard backpressure (per node)
panels.description: Red bands: at least one WAL writer on the node is refusing appends (max_total_wal_size / max_live_segments).

panels.title: Live overlay size (top 10 shards)
panels.description: Unapplied events buffered in the write overlay, right now.

panels.title: Registry size & memory (per node)
panels.description: Registry substrate size (approximate entry count) and memory, from bondy_registry:info/0 at scrape time. (The old bondy_registry_trie_* names came from a collector that was never registered — dead since authoring.)

panels.title: Penciller work backlog (max per node)
panels.description: The LSM write-stall signal: sustained backlog means compaction cannot keep up with the write rate.

panels.title: Penciller pending work
panels.description: L0 flush / manifest change pending on any bookie of the node.

panels.title: SST files per LSM level
panels.description: File distribution across ledger levels (all bookies).

panels.title: Sampled fetches by resolution level
panels.description: Where reads resolve: mem/0/1 = cache-warm; 2/3/lower = deep, read-amplified fetches.

panels.title: Mean op time (per op, max across bookies)
panels.description: Sampled (10% of ops) GET/HEAD/PUT stage means.

panels.title: Pack seals (per kind)
panels.description: seal_incoming = full synchronous seal; seal_roll = cheap synchronous half of an async seal.

panels.title: Integrity events (any cell red = investigate)
panels.description: Discrete integrity events over time. All rows should stay green.

panels.title: Router internals — RPC, listeners, jobs & limits
RPC promises in flight
panels.description: Pending calls/invocations awaiting a yield or error. Rising = callee saturation.

panels.title: Listener saturation
panels.description: Active vs max connections per ranch listener. Listeners with an unlimited max are absent.

panels.title: Partisan connections
panels.description: Connection-pool depth per peer and per channel (deeper than the connected/not-connected matrix).

panels.title: RPC timeouts & rate-limit denials
panels.description: Evicted RPC promises (caller got a WAMP timeout) and inbound requests denied by the AV-1 rate limiter. Both should normally sit at zero.

panels.title: Rate limiter & OIDC state
panels.description: Live token buckets (keyspace growth / GC health) and pending OIDC login flows.

panels.title: Singleton mailbox depth
panels.description: message_queue_len of critical singletons; a backed-up bondy_event_manager delays ALL eventing and metrics.

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Event-driven gauge, all selected nodes.

panels.title: Drops / shed (5m)
panels.description: Messages/events Bondy declined to deliver in the last 5m (bondy_wamp_dropped_total: load shedding etc.). Non-zero means a WAMP feature is degrading under load — the NATS "slow consumers" analog.

panels.title: Session close reasons
panels.description: Sessions closed per second by WAMP close reason URI. A spike of abnormal reasons (ping timeouts, errors) is the "why are my clients dropping" diagnostic.

panels.title: Sockets & connections
panels.description: WAMP transport sockets by transport (raw = TCP raw socket, ws = WebSocket) with error rates, plus HTTP-layer connections per ranch listener (plain HTTP has no per-connection Bondy process; ranch is its source of truth and includes pre-upgrade WS connections).

panels.title: Ping RTT (quantiles)
panels.description: Round-trip time of router-initiated transport pings, per transport (ws | raw). Client connectivity health as seen from the router.

panels.title: WAMP message mix
panels.description: WAMP messages routed per second, by message type. One query per type family: rate() drops __name__, so a multi-name regex selector collides ("vector cannot contain metrics with the same labelset") — this panel was broken since authoring.

panels.title: Call latency
panels.description: Round trip from the dealer receiving CALL to the first RESULT/ERROR, all procedures.

panels.title: Callee vs router time (p95)

targets.expr: clamp_min(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(bondy_wamp_call_latency_milliseconds_bucket{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))) - histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(bondy_wamp_invocation_latency_milliseconds_bucket{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))), 0)

panels.description: Latency attribution: call = full CALL round trip; callee = INVOCATION to YIELD leg (application execution + transport); router overhead = the difference (approximate — quantiles do not subtract exactly). Answers "is it Bondy or is it the callee?".

panels.title: In-flight invocations by procedure (top 10)
panels.description: Pending invocations per procedure, computed from the live promise store at scrape time (drift-free). Rising values mean that procedure's callee is saturating — the per-procedure consumer-lag analog.

panels.title: Dropped by reason
panels.description: bondy_wamp_dropped_total rate by reason and family (e.g. shed meta events under load). Should be zero.

panels.title: Request rate by route
panels.description: API Gateway requests per second by route template.

panels.title: Error rate by route (%)
panels.description: Share of requests per route answered with a 4xx/5xx class status.

panels.title: Request duration p95 by route
panels.description: API Gateway request duration p95 per route template.

panels.title: Scheduler time by state (msacc)
panels.description: BEAM scheduler wall-time share by microstate-accounting state. One query per state metric (multi-name rate() selectors collide after __name__ is dropped).

panels.title: System monitor events
panels.description: long_gc / long_schedule / large_heap / busy_port / busy_dist_port. Red cells mark scheduler stalls or GC pressure.
